visibility.updates: existing active project check-ins and material milestones

lanes.result: Independent review rejected the first detached garment rebuild for six overlaps at rest. A later hem join cleared its neutral seam check, and the corrected left cuff was built but remains unverified. No walk or run is accepted.
lanes.next: Verify the corrected cuff against the original outline and check for overlaps. Resolve the visible seam decision before separating the fasteners. Nothing is installed.

lanes.result: Larger logs and the emblem read in the detached still. An isolated Godot route verified all three original starter pickups as distinct committed sources. Separate carried visuals are not installed.
lanes.next: Build and verify larger carry mounts and the real transfer route; the current bundled display does not qualify.

lanes.result: Corner-only paint conditions verified in a paired isolated Godot test. No paid fill or shrink is installed.
lanes.next: The native corner test and distinct pickup identities hold. A portable source-to-carry ownership bridge is tested, but the finish sweep needs real individual mounts and actual purchase-deck arrivals.

lanes.result: 47 Level 1 scenarios scoped. The isolated Godot audio player passed 131 checks across four modes without exit leaks. This verifies player behavior, not audible playback or installed game audio.
lanes.next: Stage a clearly opt-in listening preview; verify audible playback and device mix before any integration.

lanes.result: Detached stock-handling visibility and input preflight staged, no customer, serving or payment authority installed.
lanes.next: Compact input-observer source and donor evidence are ready, but a safe isolated native test host remains pending. No interaction or payment is implemented.

lanes.result: Enemy animals are in scope, fish are not. No approved runtime species, encounter or reward tied to this build.
lanes.next: Lock the authored Level 1 enemy asset and real encounter authority before adding combat or related sound.

office_events.message: Handoff summary: The independently reproduced overlaps span the boots, knees, and hems. The current pose stays rejected; one same-look detached rebuild is the next test.
Handoff summary: The three original starter pickups were verified as separate committed sources. The current grouped carry display stayed unchanged; it cannot trigger the purchase sweep.
Handoff summary: The first detached garment rebuild failed with six overlaps at rest. Keep it out of the game and verify any revised garment at rest before testing gait.
